title: Authorities in France examine debris to see if it came from a plane that vanished

images.subtitle: July 29, 2015
images.caption: French police officers carry a piece of debris from a plane on Reunion Island. Air safety investigators, one of them from Boeing, have identified the component as a flaperon from the trailing edge of a Boeing 777 wing, a U.S. official said.

images.subtitle: July 30, 2015
images.caption: A member of a local shore-cleaning association on Reunion Island holds the remains of a suitcase found on the same site where he and his fellow association members also found a piece of plane wreckage that could be from the missing Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

images.subtitle: July 31, 2015
images.caption: A liquid soap container label from Jakarta, Indonesia, that was part of newly discovered debris washed onto the beach on Reunion Island.

images.subtitle: July 29, 2015
images.caption: This image taken from video shows a piece of debris from a plane on Reunion Island.

images.subtitle: July 31, 2015
images.caption: Workers for an association responsible for maintaining paths to the beaches on Reunion Island search the beach for possible additional airplane debris near the area where an airplane part was washed up.

images.subtitle: July 30, 2015
images.caption: A French law enforcement helicopter flies over the beach on Reunion Island in hopes of finding more plane debris.

images.subtitle: July 31, 2015
images.caption: The shore where plane debris and a piece of luggage were found.

images.subtitle: July 30, 2015
images.caption: Dai Shuqin, 62, cries as she talks to reporters in Beijing after hearing about the recent discovery of plane debris that could be from the missing plane. Dai’s sister and her family were on the plane.

images.subtitle: July 31, 2015
images.caption: Members of French law enforcement carry a wooden box containing the wing part that was washed up on the beach as they maneuver it into a van, ready to be put onto a flight to France to undergo further investigation.

images.subtitle: July 31, 2015
images.caption: Police officers escort an airport vehicle transporting what is believed to be debris from the plane.

images.subtitle: Aug. 1, 2015
images.caption: A white van accompanied by police motorcycles and a police car transporting what is believed to be debris from a Boeing 777.

images.subtitle: July 31, 2015
images.caption: A white van carrying the wing part is filmed by a television cameraman as it receives a vehicle escort by the French gendarmerie while driving to a cargo hangar at the airport.

images.subtitle: Aug. 2, 2015
images.caption: Police officers carry a container holding metallic debris found on a beach in Saint-Denis on Reunion Island close to where where a Boeing 777 wing part believed to belong to missing Flight 370 washed up last week.

images.subtitle: Aug. 2, 2015
images.caption: Metallic debris found on a beach in Saint-Denis.

items.content: Investigators think the piece is from the aircraft, but after so long, it won’t help in narrowing the search area.
